answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using epoch-gated verifiable delay functions. Each round, a public randomness beacon emits an unpredictable seed, and an agent must submit a sequential squaring proof bound to its key within a strict time delta to begin its operational voyage on the network. Because VDF evaluation resists parallel speedup, attackers must dedicate hardware execution pipelines and energy per fake identity. However, ASIC farms can still mint clones concurrently.
